# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the current content of the `main` branch gets security fixes. The site at <https://gt7tutor.app> is built from it.

## Report a vulnerability

Do not report a vulnerability in a public issue.
Use the private report on GitHub: open the **Security** tab of the repository and select **Report a vulnerability**.

Give this information:

- the page address,
- the browser and the operating system,
- the steps that show the problem,
- what an attacker can do.

You get an answer within 14 days.

## Scope

This repository holds a static landing page. It has no server code, no forms and no user accounts.
For a vulnerability in the GT7 Tutor application, use the private report of the main project: <https://github.com/alex-yurchenko-85/gt7-tutor/security/advisories/new>.

These are not vulnerabilities:

- a problem of GitHub Pages or of the domain name service,
- a problem that needs an attacker who can read or change the traffic of the visitor.
